# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive bilingual dictionary from Cambridge University Press providing English-French translations with corpus-based examples from Europarl, Hansard archive, and Cambridge English Corpus.

Cambridge Dictionary offers authoritative word definitions, translations, and usage examples across multiple languages. The platform draws on extensive linguistic corpora including the Europarl Parallel Corpus and Hansard archive to provide real-world context for translations, serving language learners and translators worldwide.

## Key Topics

- English-French translation
- Bilingual dictionary
- Cambridge English Corpus
- Europarl Parallel Corpus
- Word definitions
- Language learning
- Vocabulary reference
- Translation examples
- Multilingual translations
- Cambridge University Press
- Hansard archive
- Idiom definitions
- Phrasal verbs
- Word of the Year
